# Store physical model usage handoff

Owner frozen pending root integrated acceptance. No commits, goal edits, external model calls, or emit writes. Unrelated user UI/docs preserved.

## Implemented

- Native schema v9 identity/attribution/final claim/pre-capture child closure; claims and Run/Task/parent projections commit in one optimistic-CAS SQLite transaction.
- Private preparation/lease/fence authority; source verification; logical response linkage is display-only for attributed calls. Legacy unattributed history retains old accounting.
- One immutable final observation; late known receipt upgrades logical unknown without changing execution revisions, lifecycle, completion, checkpoint or continuation proof.
- Completion/checkpoint separately require logical settlement. Sealed completion/continued predecessor accepts exact claimed receipt duplicates only.
- Summary completeness plus knownBudgetCostUsd lower bound; immutable predecessor weighted/priced subtotals used at final Store admission.
- Coherent Run accounting/replay snapshots and revision-retried Thread export; recovery refresh preserves canonical accounting, stale finish caller cannot overwrite it.
- Imported physical/child IDs and attribution/receipt/advisor hashes rebound; source hashes retained; imported rows never gain native attribution. Duplicate local import receipts replaced by fresh provenance on reimport. Private native leases allow genuine post-cutoff calls.

## Evidence

- 93/93: /tmp/napier-accounting-final-regression-v2.json (9 files: Store, boundaries, first continuation case, schema migration, indexed query, thread bundle, completion, checkpoint, continuation repository).
- 2/2 final continuation tests: /tmp/napier-accounting-continuation-v3.json. Includes late successor usage preserving predecessor byte-for-byte and estimated source-cost continuation refusal.
- Strict production and selected-test compile: /tmp/napier-store-accounting-strict-tsconfig.json; empty /tmp/napier-store-accounting-strict-types-v3.log.
- Independent shared-owner read-only audit found no further concrete Store defect after advisor rehash and canonical continuation-admission fix.
- Worker actual advisor import/export twice test passes in its dispatch suite, with new physical/review hashes and stable input/prompt/response hashes.
- Root owns real provider-lifetime/SIGKILL/host reopen evidence; these Store fixtures alone do not establish those outcomes.

## Architecture

No new Store/SQLite/fold/cycle violations. Last audit /tmp/napier-accounting-final-architecture-v2.log has existing external failures and reduced stale Store limits: LOC3741, fanout77, coupling9702 (root may lower, never increase). Other team edits can change fan-in.

## Files

Exact path/hash inventory is in /tmp/napier-late-usage-store-handoff-20261030.json. Contracts model-accounting.ts and worker child types/budget/continuation-evaluation are separate owners.
